visual_appeal: Lock every state chip to a 118px column so FULL, NEARLY FULL, NOT RESTING and MAX LEVEL share one right edge; ragged chip widths are what make the roster look unfinished.
Now-playing meter: 10px tall, track #1c1612, fill #c4473a when not resting instead of the pale blue-white sliver.
Pull the hero vignette up 8px so the green rest bar does not crowd the instruction strip.
state_colours: Now-playing fill must follow state: #d64545 not resting, #e0973a resting, #d4de4a nearly full, #3fa84a full. The pale bar contradicts the red NOT RESTING chip.
Nearly-full yellow is too close to title gold #e6d3a1. Use #d4e04a bars and #f0f4a8 text on #3d4210 chips so 90%+ is not read as chrome.
Left row ticks are about 3px; make them 4px and full row height so the colour key reads before the bar.
character_identity: Row portraits are too small. Use 36px rings in the list and 46px for now-playing, with a 2px class-colour ring.
On fill #16120e, lift warrior/tan names to #e2b56a and grey max-level names to #cfcfcf so class colour still identifies them.
Jacques Hammer's red mask reads as a missing face next to Le Nette. If the live portrait fails, show a class icon on a #2a2118 disc, not an unlabeled red blob.
default_theme: Outer frame should be 1px #7a6238 plus 7px bronze corner studs, not a thick double gold rule. The frame is louder than the content.
Default Compact is a dull brown with weak affordance. Match View details: height 26px, fill #6e1d1d, border #a33a3a, label #f4e4c4 at 13px.
Inset panels need a 1px top inner highlight #3a3228 and 8px padding so sections are not flat slabs.
elvui_wc3_fit: His real titles (Options, Le Jette, Reputation) sit around 13-14px gold on near-black. Set this title to 14px #e8dcc0, not 16px.
Match his fill #100e0c and 1px border #2a241c with 5px bronze studs. Scene 02's corner brackets are heavier than the studs on his Character and Options windows.

Keep Compact as the blue enamel secondary (gradient about #163e6e to #2f6eae, same family as Defaults) and View details red like Expanded Stats. Desaturate FULL green about 15% so the window does not glow beside his quiet panels.
alerts_ux: Cap the banner at 540px and keep the X within 16px of the copy. The full-bleed bar leaves a dead gap between the message and the close control.
Details looks disabled. 22px height, label #f3e6c4, 1px #a88848 border, fill #2a2218.
On the Esc menu, align the alert to the menu's left edge, 8px below it, at the menu's width, so it attaches to Log Out instead of floating as a second panel.
readability: Meta lines ('seen 4d ago', 'none used this session', footer sync) are too dim. Minimum 12px #cbbd9a.
Put 'Acct #3' in an 11px pill 4px after the name, fill #3a2a14, text #e8b15a, so it stops colliding with Le Bankken.
Max-level line 'I keep the bench warm.' at 13px #b7aa96; the current grey disappears on the row.
layout_polish: One bar geometry: roster bars and the now-playing meter share the same x and a 120px chip column. The now-playing meter currently floats at a different width.
Character card: two equal columns, 12px gutter; let PROFESSIONS span both columns so the right cell is not an empty hole.
Add 8px between the hero instruction strip and the now-playing block; they currently touch.
delight: The roster only gives a voice to the hero and the max-level line. Add a 12px italic #d9c7a0 quip under the now-playing name when they are unrested.
2px outer glow #7dba3d at 35% opacity on the #1 portrait ring so the play-next target feels picked out.
The sleep 'z z Z' only appears on the card. One 10px zzz on a FULL row would carry that charm into the list without clutter.

overall_notes: The alert rewrite landed: one imperative headline, who and where, then how, with the next character demoted to a single line and the same pattern on the Esc strip. Sort order and the green/yellow/orange/red key are clear enough to play from. It is not a 9 for a demanding user yet. ElvUI mode is close to his real Gatewood windows but the title is a step large and the corner pieces heavier than his thin studs; the now-playing meter ignores state colour; chips do not share a column; secondary type is dim. The speech lines are the part worth keeping.
